about: Hand-kept evidence for Nandini's bookshelf: which printed books she owns, which subjects she studies, and which bundled or online books go with each subject. The importers never write this file. A title listed under physical_titles is NOT a book in the app: it has no text, cannot be searched and is never evidence for an answer.

evidence.shows: Covers and title pages of six Neuron Publication books, some photographed more than once.
does_not_show: an electronic or licensed copy of any book
that the college prescribes these books

evidence.shows: Nandini's six first-year subjects, in her order.
BNMC Diploma in Nursing Science and Midwifery Course Syllabus 2018: seven first-year subjects, Behavioral Science among them. Subject codes were taken from it on 2026-10-23.
does_not_show: which books a college must use
evidence.note: The file could not be opened from the build environment on 2026-11-12, so its units and learning outcomes have not been read into the app.

ai_use.rule: A bundled book may be sent to a language model (the phone's model, the online models, the voice tool, or the owner's server) only when it is listed under allowed. Every other book is for reading and plain search only.

allowed.basis: CC BY 4.0 (Open RN / WisTech Open), which allows reuse for any purpose with attribution. No AI restriction was recorded when the books were imported.
allowed.note: Not re-checked on 2026-11-12: the publisher's site refused the build environment.

allowed.basis: U.S. National Cancer Institute, Reuse of Text policy: "Unless otherwise indicated, all text within National Cancer Institute (NCI) products is free of copyright and may be reused without our permission. Credit the National Cancer Institute as the source."

not_permitted.basis: OpenStax statement on every book's web page: "This book may not be used in the training of large language models or otherwise be ingested into large language models or generative AI offerings without OpenStax's prior written permission." The books are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: free to share for non-commercial study with the attribution line on every page view.
